entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
Did you know that children still work in the chocolate industry so you can get your cheap chocolate?

AUT professor Tracy Berno says 60% of chocolate is produced in the Ivory Coast and Ghana, where they use child labour to keep costs down. It's a system that drives profit, over ethics and conditions.
